accept_unchanged.semantics: after the bounded wait expires without a completely stored packet revision, permit a compact state_unchanged response

websocket_state_unchanged.semantics: the prior full authoritative projection remains the independent stable sample only when turn and source_seq exactly match the caller's accepted projection

atomicity.packet_mutation: serialized by the CivCom state-projection lock
atomicity.projection_construction: serialized by the same CivCom state-projection lock
atomicity.unchanged_check: performed under the same lock after the bounded source wait

stability.decision_sample_policy: one atomic full projection followed by a bounded unchanged-revision acknowledgement is equivalent to two identical deterministic projections
stability.changed_revision_policy: a packet revision during the wait returns an ordinary full state_response and restarts fingerprint stability

invariants: accept_unchanged is valid only for a bounded pln_authoritative source wait
legacy and v3 state queries preserve their response semantics
state_unchanged is never returned when source_seq differs from after_source_seq
packet mutation cannot overlap authoritative projection construction
the client accepts state_unchanged only for its retained full projection's exact turn and source sequence
